title: Run Product CI on GitHub-hosted runners
body:
Operator 2026-10-29 approved trying GitHub-hosted runners for Product CI (amending D21, which keeps CI on the self-hosted fleet) to stop CI from competing with local agents and to avoid fleet stops on network drift. Trial on draft PR #136 (repository variable CI_RUNNER="ubuntu-latest", run 40837977888): 10 isolation tests failed with "requested PID namespace isolation is unavailable" because Ubuntu 24.04 restricts unprivileged user namespaces; the variable was removed again.
Acceptance: the CI workflow enables unprivileged user namespaces only on GitHub-hosted runners (for example sysctl kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0) and the full gate passes there with zero isolation skips; test/workflow.test.ts pins the behavior; Actions minutes per PR are measured and recorded; the D21 amendment is recorded in ADR 0014 once the trial passes; the self-hosted fleet remains the fallback.
